title: AI generated podcast
author: Theopt89
selftext:
Funny how it’s evolving, I’ve used skill capped content and patch notes for this one. Maybe next patch I’ll try other sources and see how it goes.

comments.body: So all the work in the process were done by ai? I mean including the copywriting script
